home.title: Timeless by Design.
home.subtitle: For the moments that matter. Discover exceptional timepieces where precision meets a quietly distinctive point of view.
home.heroImageAlt: A mechanical watch with an ivory dial and brown leather strap, photographed in dramatic light
home.featuredDescription: A selection of remarkable timepieces, chosen for the way they make you feel.

products.name: Heritage Automatic
products.description: A refined expression of everyday elegance.
products.details: Quietly assured, the Heritage Automatic brings a measured elegance to the everyday. Its clean proportions and softly finished case frame a dial designed to be read at a glance. A supple leather strap lends warmth to the composition, moving comfortably from a morning appointment to an unhurried evening.

gallery.imageAlt: Heritage Automatic - dial and case detail
gallery.caption: A closer look

products.name: Navigator Steel
products.description: Purposeful engineering with a distinctive steel finish.
products.details: A companion for changing horizons. The Navigator Steel pairs a purposeful silhouette with a beautifully balanced dial and the reassuring feel of a steel bracelet. Brushed surfaces catch the light with restraint, lending this versatile timepiece a character as comfortable in the city as it is beyond it.

gallery.imageAlt: Navigator Steel - dial and case detail
gallery.caption: A closer look

products.name: Méridian Chronograph
products.details: For those who take a closer look. The Méridian Chronograph celebrates the rhythm of precision through considered detailing and a beautifully layered dial. The collection balances an expressive instrument-inspired aesthetic with the ease of a timepiece made to be worn, remembered, and worn again.

gallery.imageAlt: Méridian Chronograph - dial and case detail
gallery.caption: A closer look

products.name: Atelier No. 01
products.imageAlt: Atelier No. 01, luxury limited edition timepiece
products.description: For those who see the extraordinary in the details.
products.details: An uncommon perspective on the passing of time. Atelier No. 01 brings together warm metallic tones, tactile materials, and a distinctive sense of proportion. Conceived as a small-edition study, it rewards attention with details that reveal themselves slowly.

gallery.imageAlt: Atelier No. 01 - dial and case detail
gallery.caption: A closer look

home.storyEyebrow: MORE THAN A MEASURE OF TIME
home.storyTitle:
Made with purpose.
Kept for a lifetime.
home.storyDescription: A watch is more than something you wear. It is a companion to your everyday, a witness to your milestones, a part of your story. At AUREL, we celebrate considered design and the extraordinary care behind every detail.
home.storyDetail: Inspired by the traditions of fine watchmaking. Selected for a life well lived.
home.storyImageAlt: A close study of a watch dial and its finely finished details
home.storyCaption: THE BEAUTY IS IN THE DETAILS
home.arrivalsDescription: New expressions of timeless design. Find the one that feels like you.

arrivals.name: Coastal Blue
arrivals.description: A deep blue dial made for new horizons.
arrivals.details: Inspired by the meeting of sea and sky, Coastal Blue is a study in relaxed precision. A cool-toned dial and considered steel finish offer a fresh expression of the Sport collection. Its versatile proportions make it an effortless companion for days that unfold without a plan.

gallery.imageAlt: Coastal Blue - dial and case detail
gallery.caption: A closer look

arrivals.name: Atelier Obsidian
arrivals.imageAlt: Atelier Obsidian, luxury limited edition timepiece
arrivals.description: Quiet confidence in an all-black expression.
arrivals.details: A darker expression of the Atelier spirit. Obsidian explores the interplay of shadow, texture, and reflected light, drawing the eye toward subtle changes in finish. Understated at first glance and distinctive on closer inspection, it is a timepiece with a quietly individual presence.

gallery.imageAlt: Atelier Obsidian - dial and case detail
gallery.caption: A closer look

arrivals.name: Heritage Reserve
arrivals.imageAlt: Reference watch photograph with a dark dial and a steel bracelet
arrivals.details: The Heritage Reserve distils the Classic collection into an enduring daily companion. Refined detailing and balanced proportions create a familiar ease, while its mechanical character invites a more personal connection to time. Thoughtful, composed, and ready for the next chapter.

gallery.imageAlt: Heritage Reserve - dial and case detail
gallery.caption: A closer look

arrivals.name: Méridian Rose
arrivals.imageAlt: Reference watch photograph with a dark dial, gold-toned accents and a woven strap
arrivals.description: Warm metallic details and mechanical character.
arrivals.details: Warmth meets precision in the Méridian Rose. A rose-toned case gives the chronograph a softer point of view, complemented by a carefully composed dial and supple strap. It is an expressive addition to the collection, designed for moments that deserve a little more attention.

gallery.imageAlt: Méridian Rose - dial and case detail
gallery.caption: A closer look

about.title: Our Story
about.introduction: A considered perspective on time. AUREL is a demonstration boutique exploring watches through thoughtful design, personal expression, and the pleasure of everyday rituals.
about.heroImageAlt: A watch photographed in an editorial lifestyle setting
about.craftDescription: We are drawn to the small decisions that give a watch its character: the shape of a case, the balance of a dial, and the way a surface catches the light. Our selection invites a closer look at those details, without losing sight of the experience of wearing a watch.
about.designDescription: For us, good design feels considered rather than complicated. Proportion, legibility, and texture form a language that can be expressive or restrained. The AUREL collection explores that range, helping you discover a timepiece that reflects your own point of view.
about.editorialImageAlt: A classic watch worn with tailored everyday clothing
about.imageCaption: A personal detail. An everyday companion.
